reviews.review_text:
Andrew B
Drummoyne, Australia19 contributions

3rd time here in 3 days, I am obsessed 😅
Jul 2025 • Couples
First time here had 2 drinks before going somewhere else for dinner. I had the Blonde and it was great! Happy hour before 6pm too was handy.. 

The second time we thought we would stay for dinner. They were super accommodating and moved us to a bigger table so our food had space. I wanted to try the IPA this time and the menu said it would pair well with a pork knuckle so it had to be done! 

The last time I had a pork knuckle was years ago in Deutschland. And honestly it was probably the best knuckle I had ever had, every part of the knuckle was super crackly. I was told it was a big serve and is normally shared amongst 3/4 people. As someone who eats a high protein diet (probably high fat too 😭) it was fine.. However I may have left some of the salad 😅

Now I am sitting here at 2pm on our last day in Ho Chi Minh, escaping the heat and the Pilsner is also a great beer! 120K for a Pint is actually great value too considering our hotel charges 95K for 320ml can you can buy from a Circle K.

So if you want some of the best beer in the city with food that matches the beer, this is the place for you!
